headline: Blackstone Q3 Real Estate Distributable Earnings Fall 10% Amid Rate Pressures
summary: Blackstone reported a 10% year-over-year decline in third-quarter real estate distributable earnings as private equity operations navigated higher interest rate headwinds.
why: As the world's largest alternative asset manager, Blackstone's earnings reflect broader valuation and liquidity trends in commercial real estate and private credit markets.

impacts.name: Blackstone Inc.
impacts.why: Elevated borrowing costs and subdued transaction volumes weigh on real estate asset realizations and distributable earnings.

why_moved: A drop in real estate distributable earnings highlights the ongoing drag of elevated interest rates on private equity asset valuations and dealmaking.
